keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «탐험가들이 가장 깊은 바닥에서도 생물을 찾아냈다(핵심 사실)» 와 «깊은 바다는 우리 지구에 아직 수수께끼가 많다는 것을 알려 준다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the key fact (explorers have found living things at the very bottom) and the conclusion (the deep sea shows that our planet still holds many mysteries). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: The Mariana Trench, the deepest place on Earth

boxes.qen: What is it like at the bottom?
boxes.a: Dark, near freezing, and under huge pressure
Living things, even at the very bottom

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: A trench is a long, narrow valley on the sea floor.
a long, narrow, deep valley in the sea floor
Pressure means the weight of the water pushing down on everything.
the force of something pushing on something else

our own planet still holds many mysteries

qs.q: Why is it completely dark at the bottom of the Mariana Trench?
qs.qko: 마리아나 해구 바닥은 왜 완전히 깜깜한가요?
opts: Because sunlight cannot reach that far
Because the water is near freezing
Because tiny animals block the light
evs: Down there, it is completely dark, because sunlight cannot reach that far.
The water is near freezing, and the pressure is enormous.
Tiny shrimp-like animals and strange single-celled creatures survive there.
A trench is a long, narrow valley on the sea floor.
why: 햇빛이 그렇게 깊은 곳까지 닿지 못하기 때문에 완전히 깜깜하다고 했어요. 물이 차가운 것은 어둠의 이유가 아니에요.
It is completely dark because sunlight cannot reach that far. The cold water is not the reason for the darkness.

qs.q: In “the pressure is enormous,” what does “enormous” mean?
qs.qko: «the pressure is enormous» 에서 «enormous» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: At the bottom, it is more than 1,000 times stronger than at the surface.
Their goal was the Mariana Trench in the Pacific Ocean.
Even today, much of the deep ocean has never been explored by humans.
For a long time, people believed nothing could live in such a place.
why: 바닥의 압력은 수면보다 1,000배 넘게 세다고 했어요. 그러니 «enormous» 는 «엄청나게 큰» 이라는 뜻이에요.
At the bottom, the pressure is more than 1,000 times stronger than at the surface, so «enormous» means extremely large.

qs.q: Why was it surprising to find life at the bottom of the trench?
qs.qko: 해구 바닥에서 생물을 찾은 것이 왜 놀라운 일이었나요?
opts: People had believed that nothing could live in such a place
People had believed that the bottom was warm and bright
People had believed that Mount Everest was under the sea
evs: For a long time, people believed nothing could live in such a place.
Amazingly, explorers have found living things at the very bottom.
If you dropped Mount Everest there, its top would still be underwater.
New kinds of animals are still discovered there every year.
why: 오랫동안 사람들은 그런 곳에서는 아무것도 살 수 없다고 믿었어요. 그런데 탐험가들이 바로 그 바닥에서 생물을 찾았어요. 두 문장을 이어야 놀라운 이유를 알 수 있어요.
People believed nothing could live there, but explorers found living things at the very bottom. You need both sentences to see why it was surprising.

ends: What strange fish live in the dark deep sea?
어두운 깊은 바다에는 어떤 신기한 물고기가 살까?
How do diving machines go so deep without breaking?
잠수정은 어떻게 부서지지 않고 그렇게 깊이 내려갈까?

write.src: “If <u>we build stronger diving machines</u>, we can <u>explore more of the deep sea</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 조건 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a condition and what we can do then in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 하는지» 를 넣어 조건을 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: If we use a strong light)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what they do to make the condition clear. (e.g. If we use a strong light)
